<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Judicial administration:</strong> The Supreme Court Collegium, led by the Chief Justice of India, has approved a new policy facilitating the early transfer of High Court Chief Justices.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Electoral and political shifts:</strong> The Election Commission has revised the schedule for electoral revisions in Odisha, even as political factions grapple with future uncertainties and the influence of youth-led digital movements on upcoming elections.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a></span></li>
